assessment.scope: One fixed WZ+0,1-jet FxFx-Delta setup and merging scale.
assessment.interpretation: The observed total-rate and broad merged-spectrum changes are modest, giving a reasonable implementation check for this fixed setup. The comparison does not demonstrate a reduction of negative-weight fractions.
assessment.uncertainty_note: HwU rate/bin errors and plot bands are conditional event/shower sampling errors at the estimated source normalization. Separately reported source integration-normalization errors are not propagated into them. Cross-run and bin covariance are not estimated; no significance is assigned to differences or ratios.
assessment.formal_accuracy_limit: This numerical check establishes neither an exact or universal NLO-matching theorem nor logarithmic accuracy or exact competing-shower correspondence.
